candidate_rule_evaluation.rule: string arguments are not compared word for word; every identifier-like token of the gold value (an email, a currency amount, a token holding a digit) that the user's input also holds must appear in the teacher's value; every other argument still compared exactly
candidate_rule_evaluation.verdict: NOT PROPOSED as tool_verification@v3: it admits 4 of 45 (3 omissions, 1 contradiction) and refuses 2 equivalent; faithfulness of a free-text summary needs a semantic judgement no deterministic rule here makes. Its ceiling is small besides: at most 9 (H-N) / 14 (H-T) of 194 single-step first candidates, and none of the full episodes, whose differing call is also unexecuted by the replay. v2 stays the rule.
